title: Smart Fertility Enhancer

sections.heading: Smart Fertility Enhancer
sections.text: Dairy cattle, especially high-yielding breeds, are prone to reproductive inefficiencies due to energy deficits, hormonal imbalances, and inflammatory stress. These challenges often manifest as irregular estrus cycles, lower conception rates, and increased Artificial Insemination reattempts. Smart Fertility Enhancer is engineered to overcome these hurdles by delivering bio-transformed Omega Fatty Acids (OFAs) in a rumen-protected form. Microencapsulation ensures that these OFAs bypass rumen degradation, thereby optimizing ovarian follicle development, hormone synthesis, and overall reproductive health. Components Rumen-Protected Omega-3 & Omega-6 Fatty Acids Rumen-Protected Amino Acids Specialized Herbal Extracts Carrier & Excipients
